verses.524: Therefore, hear the word of the LORD, you arrogant, who rule this people in Jerusalem:
verses.525: Because you say, "We have made a covenant with death, and with the nether world we have made a pact; When the overwhelming scourge passes, it will not reach us; For we have made lies our refuge, and in falsehood we have found a hiding place," -
verses.526: Therefore, thus says the Lord GOD: See, I am laying a stone in Zion, a stone that has been tested, A precious cornerstone as a sure foundation; he who puts his faith in it shall not be shaken.
verses.527: I will make of right a measuring line, of justice a level. - Hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and waters shall flood the hiding place.
verses.528: Your covenant with death shall be canceled and your pact with the nether world shall not stand. When the overwhelming scourge passes, you shall be trampled down by it.
verses.529: Whenever it passes, it shall take you; morning after morning it shall pass, By day and by night; terror alone shall convey the message.
verses.530: For the bed shall be too short to stretch out in, and the cover too narrow to wrap in.
verses.531: For the LORD shall rise up as on Mount Perazim, bestir himself as in the Valley of Gibeon, To carry out his work, his singular work, to perform his deed, his strange deed.
verses.532: Now, be arrogant no more lest your bonds be tightened, For I have heard from the Lord, the GOD of hosts, the destruction decreed for the whole earth.
verses.533: Give ear and hear my voice, pay attention and listen to what I say:
verses.534: Is the plowman forever plowing, always loosening and harrowing his land for planting?
verses.535: When he has leveled the surface, does he not scatter gith and sow cumin, Put in wheat and barley, with spelt as its border?
verses.536: He has learned this rule, instructed by his God.
verses.537: Gith is not threshed with a sledge, nor does a cartwheel roll over cumin. But gith is beaten out with a staff, and cumin crushed for food with a rod.
verses.538: No, he does not thresh it unendingly, nor does he crush it with his noisy cartwheels and horses.
verses.539: This too comes from the LORD of hosts; wonderful is his counsel and great his wisdom.
verses.540: Woe to Ariel, Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year, let the feasts come round.
verses.541: But I will bring distress upon Ariel, with mourning and grief. You shall be to me like Ariel,
verses.542: I will encamp like David against you; I will encircle you with outposts and set up siege works against you.
verses.543: Prostrate you shall speak from the earth, and from the base dust your words shall come. Your voice shall be like a ghost's from the earth, and your words like chirping from the dust.
verses.544: The horde of your arrogant shall be like fine dust, the horde of the tyrants like flying chaff. Then suddenly, in an instant,
verses.545: you shall be visited by the LORD of hosts, With thunder, earthquake, and great noise, whirlwind, storm, and the flame of consuming fire.
verses.546: Then like a dream, a vision in the night, Shall be the horde of all the nations who war against Ariel with all the earthworks of her besiegers.
verses.547: As when a hungry man dreams he is eating and awakens with an empty stomach, Or when a thirsty man dreams he is drinking and awakens faint and dry, So shall the horde of all the nations be, who make war against Zion.
verses.548: Be irresolute, stupefied; blind yourselves and stay blind! Be drunk, but not from wine, stagger, but not from strong drink!
verses.549: For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep. He has shut your eyes (the prophets) and covered your heads (the seers).
verses.550: For you the revelation of all this has become like the words of a sealed scroll. When it is handed to one who can read, with the request, "Read this," he replies, "I cannot; it is sealed."
verses.551: When it is handed to one who cannot read, with the request, "Read this," he replies, "I cannot read."
verses.552: The Lord said: Since this people draws near with words only and honors me with their lips alone, though their hearts are far from me, And their reverence for me has become routine observance of the precepts of men,
verses.553: Therefore I will again deal with this people in surprising and wondrous fashion: The wisdom of its wise men shall perish and the understanding of its prudent men be hid.
verses.554: Woe to those who would hide their plans too deep for the LORD! Who work in the dark, saying, "Who sees us, or who knows us?"
verses.555: Your perversity is as though the potter were taken to be the clay: As though what is made should say of its maker, "He made me not!" Or the vessel should say of the potter, "He does not understand."
verses.556: But a very little while, and Lebanon shall be changed into an orchard, and the orchard be regarded as a forest!
verses.557: On that day the deaf shall hear the words of a book; And out of gloom and darkness, the eyes of the blind shall see.
verses.558: The lowly will ever find joy in the LORD, and the poor rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.559: For the tyrant will be no more and the arrogant will have gone; All who are alert to do evil will be cut off,
verses.560: those whose mere word condemns a man, Who ensnare his defender at the gate, and leave the just man with an empty claim.
verses.561: Therefore thus says the LORD, the God of the house of Jacob, who redeemed Abraham: Now Jacob shall have nothing to be ashamed of, nor shall his face grow pale.
verses.562: When his children see the work of my hands in his midst, They shall keep my name holy; they shall reverence the Holy One of Jacob, and be in awe of the God of Israel.
verses.563: Those who err in spirit shall acquire understanding, and those who find fault shall receive instruction.
verses.650: Come near, O nations, and hear; be attentive, O peoples! Let the earth and what fills it listen, the world and all it produces.
verses.651: The LORD is angry with all the nations and is wrathful against all their host; he has doomed them and given them over to slaughter.
verses.652: Their slain shall be cast out, their corpses shall send up a stench; The mountains shall run with their blood,
verses.653: and all the hills shall rot; The heavens shall be rolled up like a scroll, and all their host shall wither away, As the leaf wilts on the vine, or as the fig withers on the tree.
verses.654: When my sword has drunk its fill in the heavens, lo, it shall come down in judgment upon Edom, a people I have doomed.
verses.655: The LORD has a sword filled with blood, greasy with fat, With the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of rams' kidneys; For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
verses.656: Wild oxen shall be struck down with fatlings, and bullocks with bulls; Their land shall be soaked with blood, and their earth greasy with fat.
verses.657: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of requital by Zion's defender.
verses.658: Edom's streams shall be changed into pitch and her earth into sulphur, and her land shall become burning pitch;
verses.659: Night and day it shall not be quenched, its smoke shall rise forever. From generation to generation she shall lie waste, never again shall anyone pass through her.
verses.660: But the desert owl and hoot owl shall possess her, the screech owl and raven shall dwell in her. The LORD will measure her with line and plummet to be an empty waste for satyrs to dwell in.
verses.661: Her nobles shall be no more, nor shall kings be proclaimed there; all her princes are gone.
verses.662: Her castles shall be overgrown with thorns, her fortresses with thistles and briers. She shall become an abode for jackals and a haunt for ostriches.
verses.663: Wildcats shall meet with desert beasts, satyrs shall call to one another; There shall the lilith repose, and find for herself a place to rest.
verses.664: There the hoot owl shall nest and lay eggs, hatch them out and gather them in her shadow; There shall the kites assemble, none shall be missing its mate.
verses.665: Look in the book of the LORD and read: No one of these shall be lacking, For the mouth of the LORD has ordered it, and his spirit shall gather them there.
verses.666: It is he who casts the lot for them, and with his hands he marks off their shares of her; They shall possess her forever, and dwell there from generation to generation.
verses.667: The desert and the parched land will exult; the steppe will rejoice and bloom.
verses.668: They will bloom with abundant flowers, and rejoice with joyful song. The glory of Lebanon will be given to them, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon; They will see the glory of the LORD, the splendor of our God.
verses.669: Strengthen the hands that are feeble, make firm the knees that are weak,
verses.670: Say to those whose hearts are frightened: Be strong, fear not! Here is your God, he comes with vindication; With divine recompense he comes to save you.
verses.671: Then will the eyes of the blind be opened, the ears of the deaf be cleared;
verses.672: Then will the lame leap like a stag, then the tongue of the dumb will sing. Streams will burst forth in the desert, and rivers in the steppe.
verses.673: The burning sands will become pools, and the thirsty ground, springs of water; The abode where jackals lurk will be a marsh for the reed and papyrus.
verses.674: A highway will be there, called the holy way; No one unclean may pass over it, nor fools go astray on it.
verses.675: No lion will be there, nor beast of prey go up to be met upon it. It is for those with a journey to make, and on it the redeemed will walk.
verses.676: Those whom the LORD has ransomed will return and enter Zion singing, crowned with everlasting joy; They will meet with joy and gladness, sorrow and mourning will flee.
verses.677: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib, king of Assyria, went on an expedition against all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
verses.678: From Lachish the king of Assyria sent his commander with a great army to King Hezekiah in Jerusalem. When he stopped at the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller's field,
verses.679: there came out to him the master of the palace, Eliakim, son of Hilkiah, and Shebna the scribe, and the herald Joah, son of Asaph.
verses.680: The commander said to them, "Tell King Hezekiah: Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria, 'On what do you base this confidence of yours?
verses.681: Do you think mere words substitute for strategy and might in war? On whom, then, do you rely, that you rebel against me?
verses.682: This Egypt, the staff on which you rely, is in fact a broken reed which pierces the hand of anyone who leans on it. That is what Pharaoh, king of Egypt, is to all who rely on him.
verses.683: But if you say to me: "We rely on the LORD, our God," is not he the one whose high places and altars Hezekiah removed, commanding Judah and Jerusalem to worship before this altar?'
verses.684: "Now, make a wager with my lord the king of Assyria: 'I will give you two thousand horses, if you can put riders on them.'
verses.685: How then can you repulse even one of the least servants of my lord? And yet you rely on Egypt for chariots and horsemen!
verses.686: 'Was it without the LORD'S will that I have come up to destroy this land? The LORD said to me, "Go up and destroy that land!"'"
verses.687: Then Eliakim and Shebna and Joah said to the commander, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic; we understand it. Do not speak to us in Judean within earshot of the people who are on the wall."
verses.688: But the commander replied, "Was it to you and your master that my lord sent me to speak these words? Was it not rather to the men sitting on the wall, who, with you, will have to eat their own excrement and drink their own urine?"
verses.689: Then the commander stepped forward and cried out in a loud voice in Judean, "Listen to the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
verses.690: Thus says the king: 'Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, since he cannot deliver you.
verses.691: Let not Hezekiah induce you to rely on the LORD, saying, "The LORD will surely save us; this city will not be handed over to the king of Assyria."'
verses.692: Do not listen to Hezekiah, for the king of Assyria says: 'Make peace with me and surrender! Then each of you will eat of his own vine and of his own fig tree, and drink the water of his own cistern,
verses.693: until I come to take you to a land like your own, a land of grain and wine, of bread and vineyards.
verses.694: Do not let Hezekiah seduce you by saying, "The LORD will save us." Has any of the gods of the nations ever rescued his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.695: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Where are the gods of Samaria? Have they saved Samaria from my hand?
verses.696: Which of all the gods of these lands ever rescued his land from my hand? Will the LORD then save Jerusalem from my hand?'"
verses.697: But they remained silent and did not answer him one word, for the king had ordered them not to answer him.
verses.698: Then the master of the palace, Eliakim, son of Hilkiah, Shebna the scribe, and the herald Joah, son of Asaph, came to Hezekiah with their garments torn, and reported to him what the commander had said.
verses.699: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his garments, wrapped himself in sackcloth, and went into the temple of the LORD.
verses.700: He sent Eliakim, the master of the palace, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, wrapped in sackcloth, to tell the prophet Isaiah, son of Amoz:
verses.701: "Thus says Hezekiah: 'This is a day of distress, of rebuke, and of disgrace. Children are at the point of birth, but there is no strength to bring them forth.
verses.702: Perhaps the LORD, your God, will hear the words of the commander, whom his master, the king of Assyria, sent to taunt the living God, and will rebuke him for the words which the LORD, your God, has heard. Send up a prayer for the remnant that is here.'"
verses.703: When the servants of King Hezekiah had come to Isaiah,
verses.704: he said to them: "Tell this to your master: 'Thus says the LORD: Do not be frightened by the words you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.705: I am about to put in him such a spirit that, when he hears a certain report, he will return to his own land, and there I will cause him to fall by the sword.'"
verses.706: When the commander returned to Lachish and heard that the king of Assyria had left there, he found him besieging Libnah.
verses.707: The king of Assyria heard a report that Tirhakah, king of Ethiopia, had come out to fight against him. Again he sent envoys to Hezekiah with this message: "Thus shall you say to Hezekiah, king of Judah:
verses.708: 'Do not let your God on whom you rely deceive you by saying that Jerusalem will not be handed over to the king of Assyria.
verses.709: You yourself have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the countries: They doomed them! Will you, then, be saved?
verses.710: Did the gods of the nations whom my fathers destroyed save them? Gozen, Haran, Rezeph, and the Edenites in Telassar?
verses.711: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, or a king of the cities of Sepharvaim, Hena or Ivvah?'"
verses.712: Hezekiah took the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it; then he went up to the temple of the LORD, and spreading it out before him,
verses.714: "O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, enthroned upon the cherubim! You alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made the heavens and the earth.
verses.715: Incline your ear, O LORD, and listen! Open your eyes, O LORD and see! Hear all the words of the letter that Sennacherib sent to taunt the living God.
verses.716: Truly, O LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations and their lands,
verses.717: and cast their gods into the fire; they destroyed them because they were not gods but the work of human hands, wood and stone.
verses.718: Therefore, O LORD, our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, O LORD, alone are God."
verses.719: Then Isaiah, son of Amoz, sent this message to Hezekiah: Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel: In answer to your prayer for help against Sennacherib, king of Assyria,
verses.720: this is the word the LORD has spoken concerning him: She despises you, laughs you to scorn, the virgin daughter Zion; Behind you she wags her head, daughter Jerusalem.
verses.721: Whom have you insulted and blasphemed, against whom have you raised your voice And lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel!
verses.722: Through your servants you have insulted the Lord: You said, "With my many chariots I climbed the mountain heights, the recesses of Lebanon; I cut down its lofty cedars, its choice cypresses; I reached the remotest heights, its forest park.
verses.723: I dug wells and drank water in foreign lands; I dried up with the soles of my feet all the rivers of Egypt.
verses.724: Have you not heard? Long ago I prepared it, From days of old I planned it, now I have brought it to pass: That you should reduce fortified cities into heaps of ruins,
verses.725: While their inhabitants, shorn of power, are dismayed and ashamed, Becoming like the plants of the field, like the green growth, like the scorched grass on the housetops.
verses.726: I am aware whether you stand or sit; I know whether you come or go, and also your rage against me.
verses.727: Because of your rage against me and your fury which has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and make you return the way you came.
verses.728: This shall be a sign for you: this year you shall eat the aftergrowth, next year, what grows of itself; But in the third year, sow and reap, plant vineyards and eat their fruit!
verses.729: The remaining survivors of the house of Judah shall again strike root below and bear fruit above.
verses.730: For out of Jerusalem shall come a remnant, and from Mount Zion, survivors. The zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.
verses.731: Therefore, thus says the LORD concerning the king of Assyria: He shall not reach this city, nor shoot an arrow at it, nor come before it with a shield, nor cast up siegeworks against it.
verses.732: He shall return by the same way he came, without entering the city, says the LORD.
verses.733: I will shield and save this city for my own sake, and for the sake of my servant David.
verses.734: The angel of the LORD went forth and struck down one hundred and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp. Early the next morning, there they were, all the corpses of the dead.
verses.735: So Sennacherib, the king of Assyria, broke camp and went back home to Nineveh.
verses.736: When he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer slew him with the sword and fled into the land of Ararat. His son Esarhaddon reigned in his stead.
verses.737: 2 In those days, when Hezekiah was mortally ill, the prophet Isaiah, son of Amoz, came and said to him: "Thus says the LORD: Put your house in order, for you are about to die; you shall not recover."
verses.738: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD:
verses.739: "O LORD, remember how faithfully and wholeheartedly I conducted myself in your presence, doing what was pleasing to you!" And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
verses.740: Then the word of the LORD came to Isaiah:
verses.741: "Go, tell Hezekiah: Thus says the LORD, the God of your father David: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears. I will heal you: in three days you shall go up to the LORD'S temple; I will add fifteen years to your life.
verses.742: I will rescue you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria; I will be a shield to this city."
verses.757: Isaiah then ordered a poultice of figs to be taken and applied to the boil, that he might recover.
verses.758: Then Hezekiah asked, "What is the sign that I shall go up to the temple of the LORD?"
verses.759: At that time when Merodach-baladan, son of Baladan, king of Babylon, heard that Hezekiah had recovered from his sickness, he sent letters and gifts to him.
verses.760: Hezekiah was pleased at this, and therefore showed the messengers his treasury, the silver and gold, the spices and fine oil, his whole armory, and everything that was in his storerooms; there was nothing in his house or in his whole realm that he did not show them.
verses.761: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and asked him, "What did these men say to you? Where did they come from?" Hezekiah answered, "They came to me from a distant land, from Babylon."
verses.762: "What did they see in your house?" he asked. Hezekiah replied, "They saw everything in my house; there is nothing in my storerooms that I did not show them."
verses.763: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the LORD of hosts:
verses.764: Behold, the days shall come when all that is in your house, and everything that your fathers have stored up until this day, shall be carried off to Babylon; nothing shall be left, says the LORD.
verses.765: Some of your own bodily descendants shall be taken and made servants in the palace of the king of Babylon."
verses.766: Hezekiah replied to Isaiah, "The word of the LORD which you have spoken is favorable." For he thought, "There will be peace and security in my lifetime."
verses.798: Keep silence before me, O coastlands; you peoples, wait for my words! Let them draw near and speak; let us come together for judgment.
verses.799: Who has stirred up from the East the champion of justice, and summoned him to be his attendant? To him he delivers the nations and subdues the kings; With his sword he reduces them to dust, with his bow, to driven straw.
verses.800: He pursues them, passing on without loss, by a path his feet do not even tread.
verses.801: Who has performed these deeds? He who has called forth the generations since the beginning. I, the LORD, am the first, and with the last I will also be.
verses.802: The coastlands see, and fear; the ends of the earth tremble: these things are near, they come to pass.
verses.805: But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, offspring of Abraham my friend -
verses.806: You whom I have taken from the ends of the earth and summoned from its far-off places, You whom I have called my servant, whom I have chosen and will not cast off -
verses.807: Fear not, I am with you; be not dismayed; I am your God. I will strengthen you, and help you, and uphold you with my right hand of justice.
verses.808: Yes, all shall be put to shame and disgrace who vent their anger against you; Those shall perish and come to nought who offer resistance.
verses.809: You shall seek out, but shall not find, those who strive against you; They shall be as nothing at all who do battle with you.
verses.810: For I am the LORD, your God, who grasp your right hand; It is I who say to you, "Fear not, I will help you."
verses.811: Fear not, O worm Jacob, O maggot Israel; I will help you, says the LORD; your redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.812: I will make of you a threshing sledge, sharp, new, and double-edged, To thresh the mountains and crush them, to make the hills like chaff.
verses.813: When you winnow them, the wind shall carry them off and the storm shall scatter them. But you shall rejoice in the LORD, and glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.814: The afflicted and the needy seek water in vain, their tongues are parched with thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
verses.815: I will open up rivers on the bare heights, and fountains in the broad valleys; I will turn the desert into a marshland, and the dry ground into springs of water.
verses.816: I will plant in the desert the cedar, acacia, myrtle, and olive; I will set in the wasteland the cypress, together with the plane tree and the pine,
verses.817: That all may see and know, observe and understand, That the hand of the LORD has done this, the Holy One of Israel has created it.
verses.818: Present your case, says the LORD; bring forward your reasons, says the King of Jacob.
verses.819: Let them come near and foretell to us what it is that shall happen! What are the things of long ago? Tell us, that we may reflect on them And know their outcome; or declare to us the things to come!
verses.820: Foretell the things that shall come afterward, that we may know that you are gods! Do something, good or evil, that will put us in awe and in fear.
verses.821: Why, you are nothing and your work is nought! To choose you is an abomination.
verses.822: I have stirred up one from the north, and he comes; from the east I summon him by name; He shall trample the rulers down like red earth, as the potter treads the clay.
verses.823: Who announced this from the beginning, that we might know; beforehand, that we might say it is true? Not one of you foretold it, not one spoke; no one heard you say,
verses.824: "The first news for Zion: they are coming now," or, "For Jerusalem I will pick out a bearer of the glad tidings."
verses.825: When I look, there is not one, no one of them to give counsel, to make an answer when I question them.
verses.826: Ah, all of them are nothing, their works are nought, their idols are empty wind!
verses.827: Here is my servant whom I uphold, my chosen one with whom I am pleased, Upon whom I have put my spirit; he shall bring forth justice to the nations,
verses.828: Not crying out, not shouting, not making his voice heard in the street.
verses.829: A bruised reed he shall not break, and a smoldering wick he shall not quench,
verses.830: Until he establishes justice on the earth; the coastlands will wait for his teaching.
verses.831: Thus says God, the LORD, who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spreads out the earth with its crops, Who gives breath to its people and spirit to those who walk on it:
verses.832: I, the LORD, have called you for the victory of justice, I have grasped you by the hand; I formed you, and set you as a covenant of the people, a light for the nations,
verses.833: To open the eyes of the blind, to bring out prisoners from confinement, and from the dungeon, those who live in darkness.
verses.834: I am the LORD, this is my name; my glory I give to no other, nor my praise to idols.
verses.835: See, the earlier things have come to pass, new ones I now foretell; Before they spring into being, I announce them to you.
verses.836: Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise from the end of the earth: Let the sea and what fills it resound, the coastlands, and those who dwell in them.
verses.837: Let the steppe and its cities cry out, the villages where Kedar dwells; Let the inhabitants of Sela exult, and shout from the top of the mountains.
verses.838: Let them give glory to the LORD, and utter his praise in the coastlands.
verses.839: The LORD goes forth like a hero, like a warrior he stirs up his ardor; He shouts out his battle cry, against his enemies he shows his might:
verses.840: I have looked away, and kept silence, I have said nothing, holding myself in; But now, I cry out as a woman in labor, gasping and panting.
verses.841: I will lay waste mountains and hills, all their herbage I will dry up; I will turn the rivers into marshes, and the marshes I will dry up.
verses.842: I will lead the blind on their journey; by paths unknown I will guide them. I will turn darkness into light before them, and make crooked ways straight. These things I do for them, and I will not forsake them.
verses.843: They shall be turned back in utter shame who trust in idols; Who say to molten images, "You are our gods."
verses.844: You who are deaf, listen, you who are blind, look and see!
verses.845: Who is blind but my servant, or deaf like the messenger I send?
verses.846: You see many things without taking note; your ears are open, but without hearing.
verses.847: Though it pleased the LORD in his justice to make his law great and glorious,
verses.848: This is a people despoiled and plundered, all of them trapped in holes, hidden away in prisons. They are taken as booty, with no one to rescue them, as spoil, with no one to demand their return.
verses.849: Who of you gives ear to this? Who listens and pays heed for the time to come?
verses.850: Who was it that gave Jacob to be plundered, Israel to the despoilers? Was it not the LORD, against whom we have sinned? In his ways they refused to walk, his law they disobeyed.
verses.851: So he poured out wrath upon them, his anger, and the fury of battle; It blazed round about them, yet they did not realize, it burned them, but they took it not to heart.
verses.852: But now, thus says the LORD, who created you, O Jacob, and formed you, O Israel: Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name: you are mine.
verses.853: When you pass through the water, I will be with you; in the rivers you shall not drown. When you walk through fire, you shall not be burned; the flames shall not consume you.
verses.854: For I am the LORD, your God, the Holy One of Israel, your savior. I give Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in return for you.
verses.855: Because you are precious in my eyes and glorious, and because I love you, I give men in return for you and peoples in exchange for your life.
verses.856: Fear not, for I am with you; from the east I will bring back your descendants, from the west I will gather you.
verses.857: I will say to the north: Give them up! and to the south: Hold not back! Bring back my sons from afar, and my daughters from the ends of the earth:
verses.858: Everyone who is named as mine, whom I created for my glory, whom I formed and made.
verses.859: Lead out the people who are blind though they have eyes, who are deaf though they have ears.
verses.860: Let all the nations gather together, let the peoples assemble! Who among them could have revealed this, or foretold to us the earlier things? Let them produce witnesses to prove themselves right, that one may hear and say, "It is true!"
verses.861: You are my witnesses, says the LORD, my servants whom I have chosen To know and believe in me and understand that it is I. Before me no god was formed, and after me there shall be none.
verses.862: It is I, I the LORD; there is no savior but me.
verses.863: It is I who foretold, I who saved; I made it known, not any strange god among you; You are my witnesses, says the LORD. I am God,
verses.864: yes, from eternity I am He; There is none who can deliver from my hand: who can countermand what I do?
verses.865: Thus says the LORD, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: For your sakes I send to Babylon; I will lower all the bars, and the Chaldeans shall cry out in lamentation.
verses.866: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.
verses.867: Thus says the LORD, who opens a way in the sea and a path in the mighty waters,
verses.868: Who leads out chariots and horsemen, a powerful army, Till they lie prostrate together, never to rise, snuffed out and quenched like a wick.
verses.869: Remember not the events of the past, the things of long ago consider not;
verses.870: See, I am doing something new! Now it springs forth, do you not perceive it? In the desert I make a way, in the wasteland, rivers.
verses.871: Wild beasts honor me, jackals and ostriches, For I put water in the desert and rivers in the wasteland for my chosen people to drink,
verses.872: The people whom I formed for myself, that they might announce my praise.
verses.873: Yet you did not call upon me, O Jacob, for you grew weary of me, O Israel.
verses.874: You did not bring me sheep for your holocausts, nor honor me with your sacrifices. I did not exact from you the service of offerings, nor weary you for frankincense.
verses.875: You did not buy me sweet cane for money, nor fill me with the fat of your sacrifices; Instead, you burdened me with your sins, and wearied me with your crimes.
verses.876: It is I, I, who wipe out, for my own sake, your offenses; your sins I remember no more.
verses.877: Would you have me remember, have us come to trial? Speak up, prove your innocence!
verses.878: Your first father sinned; your spokesmen rebelled against me
verses.879: Till I repudiated the holy gates, put Jacob under the ban, and exposed Israel to scorn.
verses.880: Hear then, O Jacob, my servant, Israel, whom I have chosen.
verses.881: Thus says the LORD who made you, your help, who formed you from the womb: Fear not, O Jacob, my servant, the darling whom I have chosen.
verses.882: I will pour out water upon the thirsty ground, and streams upon the dry land; I will pour out my spirit upon your offspring, and my blessing upon your descendants.
verses.883: They shall spring up amid the verdure like poplars beside the flowing waters.
verses.884: One shall say, "I am the LORD'S," another shall be named after Jacob, And this one shall write on his hand, "The LORD'S," and Israel shall be his surname.
verses.885: Thus says the LORD, Israel's King and redeemer, the LORD of hosts: I am the first and I am the last; there is no God but me.
verses.886: Who is like me? Let him stand up and speak, make it evident, and confront me with it. Who of old announced future events? Let them foretell to us the things to come.
verses.887: Fear not, be not troubled: did I not announce and foretell it long ago? You are my witnesses! Is there a God or any Rock besides me?
verses.888: Idol makers all amount to nothing, and their precious works are of no avail, as they themselves give witness. To their shame, they neither see nor know anything; and they are more deaf than men are.
verses.889: Indeed, all the associates of anyone who forms a god, or casts an idol to no purpose, will be put to shame;
verses.890: they will all assemble and stand forth, to be reduced to fear and shame.

verses.892: The carpenter stretches a line and marks with a stylus the outline of an idol. He shapes it with a plane and measures it off with a compass, making it like a man in appearance and dignity, to occupy a shrine.
verses.893: He cuts down cedars, takes a holm or an oak, and lays hold of other trees of the forest, which the Lord had planted and the rain made grow
verses.894: to serve man for fuel. With a part of their wood he warms himself, or makes a fire for baking bread; but with another part he makes a god which he adores, an idol which he worships.
verses.895: Half of it he burns in the fire, and on its embers he roasts his meat; he eats what he has roasted until he is full, and then warms himself and says, "Ah! I am warm, I feel the fire."
verses.896: Of what remains he makes a god, his idol, and prostrate before it in worship, he implores it, "Rescue me, for you are my god."
verses.897: The idols have neither knowledge nor reason; their eyes are coated so that they cannot see, and their hearts so that they cannot understand.
verses.898: Yet he does not reflect, nor have the intelligence and sense to say, "Half of the wood I burned in the fire, and on its embers I baked bread and roasted meat which I ate. Shall I then make an abomination out of the rest, or worship a block of wood?"
verses.899: He is chasing ashes-a thing that cannot save itself when the flame consumes it; yet he does not say, "Is not this thing in my right hand a fraud?"
verses.900: Remember this, O Jacob, you, O Israel, who are my servant! I formed you to be a servant to me; O Israel, by me you shall never be forgotten:
verses.901: I have brushed away your offenses like a cloud, your sins like a mist; return to me, for I have redeemed you.
verses.902: Raise a glad cry, you heavens: the LORD has done this; shout, you depths of the earth. Break forth, you mountains, into song, you forest, with all your trees. For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and shows his glory through Israel.
verses.903: Thus says the LORD, your redeemer, who formed you from the womb: I am the LORD, who made all things, who alone stretched out the heavens; when I spread out the earth, who was with me?
verses.904: It is I who bring to nought the omens of liars, who make fools of diviners; I turn wise men back and make their knowledge foolish.
verses.905: It is I who confirm the words of my servants, I carry out the plan announced by my messengers; I say to Jerusalem: Be inhabited; to the cities of Judah: Be rebuilt; I will raise up their ruins.
verses.906: It is I who said to the deep: Be dry; I will dry up your wellsprings.
verses.907: I say of Cyrus: My shepherd, who fulfills my every wish; He shall say of Jerusalem, "Let her be rebuilt," and of the temple, "Let its foundations be laid."
verses.908: Thus says the LORD to his anointed, Cyrus, whose right hand I grasp, Subduing nations before him, and making kings run in his service, Opening doors before him and leaving the gates unbarred:
verses.909: I will go before you and level the mountains; Bronze doors I will shatter, and iron bars I will snap.
verses.910: I will give you treasures out of the darkness, and riches that have been hidden away, That you may know that I am the LORD, the God of Israel, who calls you by your name.
verses.911: For the sake of Jacob, my servant, of Israel my chosen one, I have called you by your name, giving you a title, though you knew me not.
verses.912: I am the LORD and there is no other, there is no God besides me. It is I who arm you, though you know me not,
verses.913: so that toward the rising and the setting of the sun men may know that there is none besides me. I am the LORD, there is no other;
verses.914: I form the light, and create the darkness, I make well-being and create woe; I, the LORD, do all these things.
verses.915: Let justice descend, O heavens, like dew from above, like gentle rain let the skies drop it down. Let the earth open and salvation bud forth; let justice also spring up! I, the LORD, have created this.
verses.916: Woe to him who contends with his Maker; a potsherd among potsherds of the earth! Dare the clay say to its modeler, "What are you doing?" or, "What you are making has no hands"?
verses.917: Woe to him who asks a father, "What are you begetting?" or a woman, "What are you giving birth to?"
verses.918: Thus says the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, his maker: You question me about my children, or prescribe the work of my hands for me!
verses.919: It was I who made the earth and created mankind upon it; It was my hands that stretched out the heavens; I gave the order to all their host.
verses.920: It was I who stirred up one for the triumph of justice; all his ways I make level. He shall rebuild my city and let my exiles go free Without price or ransom, says the LORD of hosts.
verses.921: Thus says the LORD: The earnings of Egypt, the gain of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, tall of stature, Shall come over to you and belong to you; they shall follow you, coming in chains. Before you they shall fall prostrate, saying in prayer: "With you only is God, and nowhere else; the gods are nought.
verses.922: Truly with you God is hidden, the God of Israel, the savior!
verses.923: Those are put to shame and disgrace who vent their anger against him; Those go in disgrace who carve images.
verses.924: Israel, you are saved by the LORD, saved forever! You shall never be put to shame or disgrace in future ages."
verses.925: For thus says the LORD, The creator of the heavens, who is God, The designer and maker of the earth who established it, Not creating it to be a waste, but designing it to be lived in: I am the LORD, and there is no other.
verses.926: I have not spoken from hiding nor from some dark place of the earth, And I have not said to the descendants of Jacob, "Look for me in an empty waste." I, the LORD, promise justice, I foretell what is right.
verses.927: Come and assemble, gather together, you fugitives from among the gentiles! They are without knowledge who bear wooden idols and pray to gods that cannot save.
verses.928: Come here and declare in counsel together: Who announced this from the beginning and foretold it from of old? Was it not I, the LORD, besides whom there is no other God? There is no just and saving God but me.
verses.929: Turn to me and be safe, all you ends of the earth, for I am God; there is no other!
verses.930: By myself I swear, uttering my just decree and my unalterable word: To me every knee shall bend; by me every tongue shall swear,
verses.931: Saying, "Only in the LORD are just deeds and power. Before him in shame shall come all who vent their anger against him.
verses.932: In the LORD shall be the vindication and the glory of all the descendants of Israel."
verses.933: Bel bows down, Nebo stoops, their idols are upon beasts and cattle; They must be borne up on shoulders, carried as burdens by the weary.
verses.934: They stoop and bow down together; unable to save those who bear them, they too go into captivity.
verses.935: Hear me, O house of Jacob, all who remain of the house of Israel, My burden since your birth, whom I have carried from your infancy.
verses.936: Even to your old age I am the same, even when your hair is gray I will bear you; It is I who have done this, I who will continue, and I who will carry you to safety.
verses.937: Whom would you compare me with, as an equal, or match me against, as though we were alike?
verses.938: There are those who pour out gold from a purse and weigh out silver on the scales; Then they hire a goldsmith to make it into a god before which they fall down in worship.
verses.939: They lift it to their shoulders to carry; when they set it in place again, it stays, and does not move from the spot. Although they cry out to it, it cannot answer; it delivers no one from distress.
verses.940: Remember this and be firm, bear it well in mind, you rebels; remember the former things, those long ago:
verses.941: I am God, there is no other; I am God, there is none like me.
verses.942: At the beginning I foretell the outcome; in advance, things not yet done. I say that my plan shall stand, I accomplish my every purpose.
verses.943: I call from the east a bird of prey, from a distant land, one to carry out my plan. Yes, I have spoken, I will accomplish it; I have planned it, and I will do it.
verses.944: Listen to me, you fainthearted, you who seem far from the victory of justice:
verses.945: I am bringing on my justice, it is not far off, my salvation shall not tarry; I will put salvation within Zion, and give to Israel my glory.
verses.946: Come down, sit in the dust, O virgin daughter Babylon; Sit on the ground, dethroned, O daughter of the Chaldeans. No longer shall you be called dainty and delicate.
verses.947: Take the millstone and grind flour, remove your veil; Strip off your train, bare your legs, pass through the streams.
verses.948: Your nakedness shall be uncovered and your shame be seen; I will take vengeance, I will yield to no entreaty, says our redeemer,
verses.949: Whose name is the LORD of hosts, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.950: Go into darkness and sit in silence, O daughter of the Chaldeans, No longer shall you be called sovereign mistress of kingdoms.
verses.951: Angry at my people, I profaned my inheritance, And I gave them into your hand; but you showed them no mercy, And upon old men you laid a very heavy yoke.
verses.952: You said, "I shall remain always, a sovereign mistress forever!" But you did not lay these things to heart, you disregarded their outcome.
verses.953: Now hear this, voluptuous one, enthroned securely, Saying to yourself, "I, and no one else! I shall never be a widow, or suffer the loss of my children" -
verses.954: Both these things shall come to you suddenly, in a single day: Complete bereavement and widowhood shall come upon you For your many sorceries and the great number of your spells;
verses.955: Because you felt secure in your wickedness, and said, "No one sees me." Your wisdom and your knowledge led you astray, And you said to yourself, "I, and no one else!"
verses.956: But upon you shall come evil you will not know how to predict; Disaster shall befall you which you cannot allay. Suddenly there shall come upon you ruin which you will not expect.
verses.957: Keep up, now, your spells and your many sorceries. Perhaps you can make them avail, perhaps you can strike terror!
verses.958: You wearied yourself with many consultations, at which you toiled from your youth; Let the astrologers stand forth to save you, the stargazers who forecast at each new moon what would happen to you.
verses.959: Lo, they are like stubble, fire consumes them; They cannot save themselves from the spreading flames. This is no warming ember, no fire to sit before.
verses.960: Thus do your wizards serve you with whom you have toiled from your youth; Each wanders his own way, with none to save you.
verses.961: Hear this, O house of Jacob called by the name Israel, sprung from the stock of Judah, You who swear by the name of the LORD and invoke the God of Israel without sincerity or justice,
verses.962: Though you are named after the holy city and rely on the God of Israel, whose name is the LORD of hosts.
verses.963: Things of the past I foretold long ago, they went forth from my mouth, I let you hear of them; then suddenly I took action and they came to be.
verses.964: Because I know that you are stubborn and that your neck is an iron sinew and your forehead bronze,
verses.965: I foretold them to you of old; before they took place I let you hear of them, That you might not say, "My idol did them, my statue, my molten image commanded them."
verses.966: Now that you have heard, look at all this; must you not admit it? From now on I announce new things to you, hidden events of which you knew not.
verses.967: Now, not long ago, they are brought into being, and beforetime you did not hear of them, so that you cannot claim to have known them;
verses.968: You neither heard nor knew, they did not reach your ears beforehand. Yes, I know you are utterly treacherous, a rebel you were called from birth.
verses.969: For the sake of my name I restrain my anger, for the sake of my renown I hold it back from you, lest I should destroy you.
verses.970: See, I have refined you like silver, tested you in the furnace of affliction.
verses.971: For my sake, for my own sake, I do this; why should I suffer profanation? My glory I will not give to another.
verses.972: Listen to me, Jacob, Israel, whom I named! I, it is I who am the first, and also the last am I.
verses.973: Yes, my hand laid the foundations of the earth; my right hand spread out the heavens. When I call them, they stand forth at once.
verses.974: All of you assemble and listen: Who among you foretold these things? The LORD'S friend shall do his will against Babylon and the progeny of Chaldea.
verses.975: I myself have spoken, I have called him, I have brought him, and his way succeeds!
verses.976: Come near to me and hear this! Not from the beginning did I speak it in secret; At the time it comes to pass, I am present: "Now the Lord GOD has sent me, and his spirit."
verses.977: Thus says the LORD, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: I, the LORD, your God, teach you what is for your good, and lead you on the way you should go.
verses.978: If you would hearken to my commandments, your prosperity would be like a river, and your vindication like the waves of the sea;
verses.979: Your descendants would be like the sand, and those born of your stock like its grains, Their name never cut off or blotted out from my presence.
verses.980: Go forth from Babylon, flee from Chaldea! With shouts of joy proclaim this, make it known; Publish it to the ends of the earth, and say, "The LORD has redeemed his servant Jacob.
verses.981: They did not thirst when he led them through dry lands; Water from the rock he set flowing for them; he cleft the rock, and waters welled forth."
verses.982: (There is no peace for the wicked, says the LORD.
verses.983: 2 Hear me, O coastlands, listen, O distant peoples. The LORD called me from birth, from my mother's womb he gave me my name.
verses.984: 3 He made of me a sharp-edged sword and concealed me in the shadow of his arm. He made me a polished arrow, in his quiver he hid me.
verses.985: 4 You are my servant, he said to me, Israel, through whom I show my glory.
verses.986: Though I thought I had toiled in vain, and for nothing, uselessly, spent my strength, Yet my reward is with the LORD, my recompense is with my God.
verses.987: For now the LORD has spoken who formed me as his servant from the womb, That Jacob may be brought back to him and Israel gathered to him; And I am made glorious in the sight of the LORD, and my God is now my strength!
verses.988: It is too little, he says, for you to be my servant, to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and restore the survivors of Israel; I will make you a light to the nations, that my salvation may reach to the ends of the earth.
verses.989: Thus says the LORD, the redeemer and the Holy One of Israel, To the one despised, whom the nations abhor, the slave of rulers: When kings see you, they shall stand up, and princes shall prostrate themselves Because of the LORD who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel who has chosen you.
verses.990: Thus says the LORD: In a time of favor I answer you, on the day of salvation I help you, To restore the land and allot the desolate heritages,
verses.991: Saying to the prisoners: Come out! To those in darkness: Show yourselves! Along the ways they shall find pasture, on every bare height shall their pastures be.
verses.992: They shall not hunger or thirst, nor shall the scorching wind or the sun strike them; For he who pities them leads them and guides them beside springs of water.
verses.993: I will cut a road through all my mountains, and make my highways level.
verses.994: See, some shall come from afar, others from the north and the west, and some from the land of Syene.
verses.995: Sing out, O heavens, and rejoice, O earth, break forth into song, you mountains. For the LORD comforts his people and shows mercy to his afflicted.
verses.996: But Zion said, "The LORD has forsaken me; my Lord has forgotten me."
verses.997: Can a mother forget her infant, be without tenderness for the child of her womb? Even should she forget, I will never forget you.
verses.998: See, upon the palms of my hands I have written your name; your walls are ever before me.
verses.999: Your rebuilders make haste, as those who tore you down and laid you waste go forth from you;
verses.1000: Look about and see, they are all gathering and coming to you. As I live, says the LORD, you shall be arrayed with them all as with adornments, like a bride you shall fasten them on you.
verses.1001: Though you were waste and desolate, a land of ruins, Now you shall be too small for your inhabitants, while those who swallowed you up will be far away.
verses.1002: The children whom you had lost shall yet say to you, "This place is too small for me, make room for me to live in."
verses.1003: You shall ask yourself: "Who has borne me these? I was bereft and barren (exiled and repudiated); who has reared them? I was left all alone; where then do these come from?"
verses.1004: Thus says the Lord GOD: See, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and raise my signal to the peoples; They shall bring your sons in their arms, and your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders.
verses.1005: Kings shall be your foster fathers, their princesses your nurses; Bowing to the ground, they shall worship you and lick the dust at your feet. Then you shall know that I am the LORD, and those who hope in me shall never be disappointed.
verses.1006: Thus says the LORD: Can booty be taken from a warrior? or captives be rescued from a tyrant?
verses.1007: Yes, captives can be taken from a warrior, and booty be rescued from a tyrant; Those who oppose you I will oppose, and your sons I will save.
verses.1008: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh, and they shall be drunk with their own blood as with the juice of the grape. All mankind shall know that I, the LORD, am your savior, your redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
verses.1009: Thus says the LORD: Where is the bill of divorce with which I dismissed your mother? Or to which of my creditors have I sold you? It was for your sins that you were sold, for your crimes that your mother was dismissed.
verses.1010: Why was no one there when I came? Why did no one answer when I called? Is my hand too short to ransom? Have I not the strength to deliver? Lo, with my rebuke I dry up the sea, I turn rivers into a desert; Their fish rot for lack of water, and die of thirst.
verses.1011: I clothe the heavens in mourning, and make sackcloth their vesture.
verses.1012: The Lord GOD has given me a well-trained tongue, That I might know how to speak to the weary a word that will rouse them. Morning after morning he opens my ear that I may hear;
verses.1013: And I have not rebelled, have not turned back.
verses.1014: I gave my back to those who beat me, my cheeks to those who plucked my beard; My face I did not shield from buffets and spitting.
verses.1015: The Lord GOD is my help, therefore I am not disgraced; I have set my face like flint, knowing that I shall not be put to shame.
verses.1016: He is near who upholds my right; if anyone wishes to oppose me, let us appear together. Who disputes my right? Let him confront me.
verses.1017: See, the Lord GOD is my help; who will prove me wrong? Lo, they will all wear out like cloth, the moth will eat them up.
verses.1018: Who among you fears the LORD, heeds his servant's voice, And walks in darkness without any light, Trusting in the name of the LORD and relying on his God?
verses.1019: All of you kindle flames and carry about you fiery darts; Walk by the light of your own fire and by the flares you have burnt! This is your fate from my hand: you shall lie down in a place of pain.
